scripts.dev: npm run prepare:content && astro sync --force && astro dev --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.build: npm run prepare:content && astro sync --force && astro check && astro build && python3 scripts/check_site.py
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v
